_meta.method: live: GET https://smartsite.cloud/api/spine/property-atoms/<id>/facets (panel); mcp__Smart_Site__get_smart_site depth=node (MCP); mcp__Smart_Site__export_instrument kind=feasibility, pdftotext -layout on the returned base64 PDF (PDF). All three pulled within one 2026-09-13 ~18:20-18:35Z window.
_meta.note: displayStringsIdentical is judged per the mission's literal falsifier ('if any string differs on any surface, the row is not done; name the surface and the string') -- it covers vocabulary-token text AND the setback/buildable-figure text each surface prints for the same parcel, not only the small set of tokens the original probe-set exercised. Where a mismatch traces to a different row's mechanism (P-152 one-reader, P-154 most-current-source, P-159/Ruling-B figure policy) that attribution is stated explicitly so it is not miscounted as a fresh P-167 defect; it still makes the byte-for-byte comparison false, which is what this field measures.

mismatches: Setbacks F/S/R/Corner: panel facets envelope.setbacks = 30/5/25/-/15 (source: atom-chain, bakedAt 2026-08-05, despite top-level readPath:'record'); MCP setbacks-envelope section = 30/10/30/20 (disposition 'Present'); PDF 'WHAT BINDS IT' table = 25/5/25 (engine per-parcel adapter). Three different numbers on three surfaces for one parcel -- the F3 five-way disagreement, now three-way, still live 2026-09-13. Attributed to P-152 (one reader not yet wired to the panel or the PDF) and P-154 (most-current-source resolver not yet the PDF's source), not a P-167 vocabulary-text defect per se.

Buildable figure: panel facets payload carries buildableAreaSqFt=19052 (FIGURE-IN-PAYLOAD, a tracked P-153 finding, confirmed still present); MCP draw.overlays[envelope].basisDisplayText = 'Buildable envelope modelled from setbacks — area withheld pending an atom' (the correct 'modelled-figure-withheld' vocabulary text, no number); PDF sheet 1 prints '19,052 sq ft of buildable area' and '64% of the 29,989 sq ft lot' as a plain assertion, no withholding language at all. Attributed to P-159/Ruling-B (the PDF's own printedBuildable/buildablePdfLabel split in hauska-engine site-model.ts is not gated on an atomDid the same way the map/MCP envelope overlay is).

Setbacks: panel facets envelope.setbacks = 20/5/20 (atom-chain); MCP setbacks-envelope section = absent, disposition 'Reported absent', absence.reason 'SETBACK_ROUTER_NOT_A_DISTRICT'; PDF 'WHAT BINDS IT' table = 20/5/20 ft. Panel and PDF agree with EACH OTHER (both read the same stale atom-chain-style number) but disagree with the MCP, which correctly refuses per the P-91/Ruling-B baseline this parcel exists to exercise ('MCP refuse baseline from Ruling B', OPS-23 section 7).

Buildable figure: MCP envelope overlay is fully refused (state:'refused', reason:'atom_path_pending', reasonDisplayText:'Withheld, setbacks unruled', geom:'none'); panel envelope.status='ok' with buildableAreaSqFt present in payload; PDF sheet 1 prints a concrete '1,397 sq ft of buildable area, 42% of the 3,294 sq ft lot' with no refusal language. Same P-159/Ruling-B attribution as 34049 -- the engine's per-parcel adapter computes and prints a figure regardless of whether the record/MCP path found a ruled setback table.

PDF leg: export_instrument kind=feasibility for this parcel returned {status:'error', reason:'engine_unreachable', message:'This operation was aborted'} on two consecutive attempts (18:23:28Z and 18:24:41Z, 2026-09-13). Per the mission's own falsifier class (a leg that cannot run is unmeasured, not failed), the PDF comparison for this parcel is UNMEASURED, not a byte-level finding. Retried once per F14's precedent (the point-route hang is intermittent, not a state) before stopping, per the two-strikes rule.

Zoning-absence text (panel vs MCP, PDF not available): panel envelope.disclosure = 'No zoning district observed for parcel — honest absence, no fallback district invented.' (a full humanized sentence); MCP zoning section disposition='absent' dispositionDisplayText='Reported absent' (fine), but the MCP envelope overlay reason is the bare internal code 'no-zoning-stamp' with reasonDisplayText literally equal to 'no-zoning-stamp' (unhumanized -- 'no-zoning-stamp' does not appear anywhere in the P-91 v3 VOCABULARY table or the atom-contract display catalog; envelopeHuman in legacy-design-tools mcp-app.ts maps only the single token atom_path_pending, per the 2026-09-11 verify doc, so every other decline reason ships raw). This alone is sufficient to fail displayStringsIdentical for this parcel independent of the missing PDF leg.

Zoning-absence text: panel envelope.disclosure = 'No zoning district observed for parcel — honest absence, no fallback district invented.'; MCP envelope overlay reasonDisplayText = 'no-zoning-stamp' (raw, unhumanized, same defect class as 113408); PDF prints the identical bare code twice -- 'WHAT BINDS IT / Zoning / no-zoning-stamp' and, in the detail table, 'Zoning district UNAVAILABLE No matching record was found for this fact. no-zoning-stamp'. MCP and PDF agree with each other (both leak the raw code) but neither matches the panel's humanized sentence, and none of the three route this through the shared vocabulary's own tokens.

Buildable-refusal text: PDF prints 'Buildable area is refused: pending -- build-to-line governs (scalar setback silent)', which is the atom-contract display package's own not_specified.pdfLabel (verified by source read: this exact sentence is not hardcoded in hauska-engine, unlike the buildable-with-area/provisional override at site-model.ts:658-660) -- correctly vocabulary-sourced. MCP's own equivalent disposition is again the raw 'no-zoning-stamp' via the envelope overlay reasonDisplayText, not the vocabulary's not_specified text either. So even where the PDF correctly uses the shared vocabulary, the MCP does not, for the same underlying disposition.

This is the negative-control parcel for P-153 (no district, no polygon anywhere) -- zoning correctly absent on all three surfaces at the DATA level; the finding here is purely about which TEXT represents that absence.

This is the cleanest apples-to-apples P-167 case: zoning (SF-2) and setback NUMBERS (25/5/10/15) agree byte-for-byte across panel, MCP and PDF -- the one parcel of the five where the underlying facts do not disagree. The remaining mismatch is purely textual: MCP's envelope overlay reason='atom_path_pending' -> reasonDisplayText='Withheld, setbacks unruled' (the vocabulary's canonical humanization); PDF's buildable-refusal reason is the hardcoded literal 'pending — buildable-envelope atom not yet on file' (hauska-engine packages/engine-core/src/site-plan/site-model.ts:658-660, a DELIBERATE override with a code comment citing P-159/Ruling-B: it substitutes this fixed string in place of the shared vocabulary's own pdfLabel specifically for the buildable-with-area/provisional kinds, because that pdfLabel would otherwise carry a raw figure the PDF must not print). Both are honest refusals for essentially the same reason (no atom yet), worded two different ways by design, not by omission -- named precisely rather than merged into the noisier P-152/P-154 findings above.

Out of scope for this lane to fix (mission excludes new vocabulary tokens): reconciling this would need either a third shared token for 'buildable figure withheld, non-map surface' or accepting the two wordings as a permanent, documented exception.
